new_result.interpretation: The unanimous first-choice causal discriminator cannot currently be executed from the tested public EarthScope 2013 waveform route. This does not confirm or falsify cross-talk. It establishes that public response metadata presence is not public waveform availability and is not proof of physical channel health.

whole_picture_so_far.fact_1: CTBTO material independently documents an H10S1 electronic-noise fault beginning 2013-07-19, evolving to persistent noise with varying cross-talk into H10S2/H10S3 and associated deployed calibration-response changes; possible riser failure was presented as an interpretation, not a proven mechanism.
whole_picture_so_far.fact_2: The public EarthScope StationXML representation used by JANUS is static across the 2013 fault era for all six HA10 EDH channels: one 2004-open epoch, zero pre/post fixed-frequency response delta in the audit, and no fault-era metadata boundary.
whole_picture_so_far.fact_3: Because the public response representation does not encode the documented 2013 change, applying that StationXML cannot explicitly compensate a time-varying fault-era transfer-path change absent from the metadata.
whole_picture_so_far.fact_4: JANUS 2014-2015 public waveforms repeatedly show an approximately 12-13 dB broadband H10S2-over-H10N1 power excess. Raw-to-public-response-corrected cross-station ratios change only by roughly tenths of a dB, so the public correction neither creates nor removes the large offset.
whole_picture_so_far.fact_5: The later S2/N1 offset is broadband/scale-like and persistent in December 2014, while January strict per-window scalar generalization fails despite central medians remaining near the same baseline scale. The compact morphology is persistent baseline plus episodic residuals, not one exact scalar in every window.
whole_picture_so_far.fact_6: The in-band event positive control failed primarily on H10S2 because its matched-noise baseline was much higher; this is compatible with measurement-path contamination but does not identify the mechanism.
whole_picture_so_far.fact_7: The JANUS-selected direct raw six-channel pre/post 2013 test is now blocked: every one of 240 frozen EarthScope waveform requests returned 404 no-data, while response metadata for all six channels remained available.
whole_picture_so_far.fact_8: A physical seabed structure, if present, is independent of hydrophone electronics and must persist in native bathymetry/backscatter. PDC/01236 contains H10N1 in its bounding geometry but not H10S2, and exact native swath/track crossing at the frozen points remains an independent open gate.
whole_picture_so_far.assistant_current_hypothesis: The most economical picture remains at least two superposed lanes: (A) a real, historically documented south-triplet measurement-path problem that is not represented by the public StationXML and may contribute to later H10S2 noise/scale behavior; plus (B) persistent site/propagation/seabed geometry that cannot be adjudicated by the electronics lane. The blocked 2013 public-waveform gate prevents assigning how much of the later 12-13 dB belongs to each lane.
whole_picture_so_far.strongest_countermodel: The large S2/N1 baseline could substantially predate the 2013 fault and reflect persistent south-vs-north site/trunk/propagation differences, with the documented fault adding only intermittent residual contamination. The unavailable 2013 public waveforms mean this countermodel remains alive.

available_next_discriminators.first_available_six_channel_baseline: Find the earliest public epoch where all six HA10 EDH waveform channels are simultaneously available; freeze windows before inspection, then measure whether the large S2/N1 baseline is already present and inspect six-channel coupling morphology.
available_next_discriminators.calibration_sequence_public_recovery: Search public/archival CTBTO, EarthScope/IRIS, papers, attachments and calibration-bit products for actual H10S calibration-sequence bytes/curves or earlier waveform/calibration records that can bridge the missing 2013 public time series.
available_next_discriminators.native_bathymetry_swath_intersection: Continue the independent physical lane and establish exact native multibeam/backscatter/swath crossing and morphology at the frozen H10 points without relying on hydrophone calibration.
available_next_discriminators.custodian_reply: Use EarthScope/CTBTO response to request/access authoritative historical waveform/calibration provenance if public archive remains incomplete.
